notes: Voice messages. A voice note you receive no longer starts over by itself when it ends: it plays once and stops. When several voice notes arrive one after another, finishing one moves straight on to the next, and only one note ever plays at a time. Recording works like WhatsApp and Telegram: hold the mic button to record and let go to send. To keep recording hands-free, slide up to the lock; to throw a recording away, slide back toward the text box. The screen now stays on for as long as you record, so a long note is no longer cut off when the screen would have gone dark. "Connecting…" now also shows on the main screen and the chats list whenever the app is reconnecting, not only inside a chat, and coming back to the app refreshes the list straight away. Games: a blackjack table that people have joined but the opener hasn't dealt yet is offered as "continue" again instead of looking finished.
